misty.editor.title: HUD editor
misty.editor.hint1: Drag a module to move it · Click to turn it on or off
misty.editor.hint2: Scroll to resize · Right-click to reset
misty.settings.title: Mistly settings
misty.option.customMenu.tip: Replaces the Minecraft main menu with the Mistly one.
misty.option.hud.tip: Shows the HUD modules in game (FPS, keystrokes, coordinates…).
misty.option.hitboxes.tip: Shows the hitbox of the entities around you, like F3 + B, without opening F3.
misty.option.network.tip: The other Mistly players see your Mistly badge and cosmetics, and you see theirs. Off: nothing is sent and nothing is fetched.
misty.option.cosmetics.tip: Shows the Mistly capes and elytra: yours, equipped in the launcher, and the other players'.
misty.module.ping.color.tip: Green when your connection is good, then yellow, orange and red as your ping grows.
misty.module.reach.color.tip: The farther the hit, the redder: green up to 2 blocks, yellow around 2.6, red at 3 blocks.
misty.module.effects.name: Effect name
misty.module.effects.name.tip: The name of each effect with its level, like Speed II.
misty.module.effects.duration.tip: The time left, right under the name.
misty.module.effects.blink.tip: The time turns red and blinks in the last 10 seconds.
misty.module.effects.hideVanilla.tip: The game's effect icons at the top right are no longer drawn.
misty.wardrobe.title: Wardrobe
misty.wardrobe.subtitle: Click to equip, drag yourself to turn around.
misty.wardrobe.off: Mistly cosmetics are turned off in the Mistly settings.
misty.settings.general.text: The Mistly menus and loading screen.
misty.settings.hud.text: Modules on your screen in game.
misty.settings.zoom.text: Hold the key to zoom, scroll to change how much.
misty.settings.fullbright.text: See everything, even in caves and at night.
misty.settings.cosmetics.text: Your cape, and the Mistly players around you.
misty.option.zoom.tip: Hold the zoom key (C by default, change it in Options › Controls) to zoom in.
misty.option.zoomSmooth.tip: The zoom glides in and out instead of jumping.
misty.option.zoomScroll.tip: While zooming, the mouse wheel zooms more or less.
misty.option.fullbright.tip: Everything is lit: caves, nights, the Nether. A key can switch it in game (Options › Controls).
misty.option.motionBlur.tip: Each image of the world is mixed with the last ones: turning and running leave a trail. The HUD stays sharp.
misty.option.particles.tip: More hit particles (crits, sharpness). The gear sets how many.
misty.option.invisibleBlocks.tip: Shows the barriers and light blocks around you, in any game mode.
misty.settings.pvp.text: See more of the fight: lower fire and shield, shorter swords.
misty.option.lowFire.tip: The flames on the screen when you burn are drawn lower, so they hide less.
misty.option.lowShield.tip: Your shield is held lower in first person, so it hides less of the screen.
misty.option.shortSword.tip: Swords are drawn smaller in your hand in first person.
misty.option.killSound.tip: A ting each time a player or mob you hit dies.
misty.option.zoomReset.tip: The wheel's change only lasts while the key is held: each zoom starts from the level set below.
misty.option.nametagBadge.tip: The Mistly cloud in front of the Mistly players' name above their head.
misty.option.ownNametag.tip: Your own name above your head, seen in third person (F5).
